label: Wheelchair accessible
description: Step-free entrance, doorways, and hallways wide enough for a wheelchair.

label: Roll-in exam table
description: Height-adjustable exam table you can transfer onto from a wheelchair.

label: Transfer lift
description: Patient lift and trained staff to help with transfers.

label: Accessible restroom
description: Restroom with grab bars and room to turn a wheelchair.

label: Accessible parking
description: Accessible parking spaces close to the entrance.

label: ASL interpreter
description: American Sign Language interpreter, in person or by video.

label: Language interpreter
description: Interpreter for languages other than English.

label: Text-based communication
description: Book, check in, and talk with staff by text or in writing.

label: Plain-language explanations
description: Staff explain things in everyday words and check that you understood.

label: Low-sensory environment
description: Quiet room, dimmable lights, and little background noise.

label: Large print or Braille
description: Forms and instructions in large print or Braille.

label: Hearing loop
description: Assistive listening system that works with hearing aids.

label: Extended appointments
description: Longer appointment times when you need them.

label: Support person welcome
description: A caregiver, friend, or support person can join you.

label: Service animals welcome
description: Service animals are welcome in all patient areas.
